items.name: DFW Cubing Spring 2024
items.information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

# ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.***

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2024#35854-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 
	
To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

items.name: Please Be Quiet Brisbane 2024

venue.name: Northside Christian College
venue.address: 151 Flockton St, Everton Park QLD 4053, Australia

items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)

Please note, this competition includes only blindfolded events, clock and FMC. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced.

Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving.

This will be allocated on a first-come-first serve basis in order of payment.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Jagera and Turrbal people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.name: NZ South Island Championship 2024
items.information:
NZ South Island Championship 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. 

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.name: Solar Eclipse in Sycamore 2024
items.information:
### This competition takes place on a Monday

Sycamore Ohio is located directly in the path of a total Solar Eclipse on April 8th, 2024. There will be dedicated time in the schedule to view the eclipse. Eclipse glasses will be provided for all competitors and guests.
